_comment: PARTNER2 — the phone normalization corpus, read by BOTH suites. One rule in two languages; the corpus is the referee. Doctrine A's pattern (services/vesting_cases.json) applied to a smaller problem: the officer types in the browser and the API can be posted to directly, so the rule exists twice and must not drift. `stored` is what the column must hold; `display` is what a human must read back.

cases.why: the ordinary case — as she types it
hyphens — the most common thing already in the column
already E.164 — normalizing must be idempotent
an extension is INFORMATION — kept verbatim, never truncated to fit the column's preferred shape
an international number is not ours to reformat
a note the officer left herself is still data — we do not discard what we cannot parse
too few digits to be a US number — left alone rather than padded or rejected
